name: WARNING: Panera Green Goddess Cobb Salad with Chicken
whyItWorks: A dense roughage trap: raw chopped romaine and baby arugula, whole pickled red onions, raw diced red onions, hard-boiled eggs, bacon grease, gorgonzola cheese crumbles, and high-fat herb buttermilk dressing. Violent scraping and allium fermentation.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Skip cold salads at Panera during active inflammation. Choose a warm, plain roasted turkey sandwich.
